blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the current front, back and three-quarter renders: the jacket still reads mainly as plain ivory with a broad flat diagonal lavender band and sparse buttons; tailored seam detailing and clear rear finishing remain absent.
Direct inspection of arms-up and arm-cross: the lavender elbow diamonds remain oversized, with angular and corrugated folds around the shoulders, underarms and sleeves.

The new 30 mm forward-scoop trial leaves substantial upper-thigh coverage gaps in direct crouch and sit inspection; the front hem forms sharp triangular flares at the bent knees instead of a smooth covering drape. Current pose-matched overskirt ray coverage (left/right) is crouch 0.4384/0.426 and sit 0.3424; prior trial was crouch 0.3774/0.3661 and sit 0.2576/0.2881. Improvement is measured, but the direct images and gaps remain a visual blocker; prototype metrics grant no fit acceptance.
Direct inspection of prone: the garment remains collapsed into a stiff, irregular fan with distorted sleeve and skirt surfaces; the forward scoop does not resolve the drape defect.

Direct inspection of left and right side renders: skirt folds remain faceted, the waist-to-skirt transition is abrupt, and the newly projected front panel has an angular flare at the knee rather than a sewn-looking contour.
Direct inspection of back: the rear remains largely featureless ivory without clear rear finishing or waist-adjustment detail.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
